notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes: A discrete-time Markov chain in the PRISM language, which Storm and PRISM read: Rubicon's model of the weather factory, or the chain dice2prism.py writes of a Dice program, with its properties.
tabs.says: A translation of the original into PRISM; the line under each file names the script that wrote it.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the in-process time leaves it out.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; its time includes Julia's compilation and the search for a contraction order.

#lang roulette/example/disrupt
;; bn_cancer.dice, translated by tddlog's scripts/dice2roulette.py.

(define complement?
  (not (member "--no-complement" (vector->list (current-command-line-arguments)))))

;; Integers: lists of Booleans, least significant bit first.
(define (bxor a b) (! (<=> a b)))
(define (bv-add xs ys [c #f])
  (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (let* ([x (car xs)] [y (car ys)] [s (bxor x y)])
        (cons (bxor s c) (bv-add (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (|| (&& x y) (&& c s)))))))
(define (bv-sub xs ys) (bv-add xs (map ! ys) #t))
(define (bv-mul xs ys)
  (define w (length xs))
  (for/fold ([acc (make-list w #f)]) ([y (in-list ys)] [i (in-naturals)])
    (if (eq? y #f)
        acc
        (bv-add acc (append (make-list i #f) (for/list ([x (in-list (take xs (- w i)))]) (&& y x)))))))
(define (bv-eq xs ys) (apply && (map <=> xs ys)))
(define (bv-ult xs ys)
  (for/fold ([lt #f]) ([x (in-list xs)] [y (in-list ys)])
    (|| (&& (! x) y) (&& (<=> x y) lt))))
(define (bv-shl xs k)
  (define w (length xs))
  (take (append (make-list (min k w) #f) xs) w))
(define (bv-shr xs k)
  (define j (min k (length xs)))
  (append (drop xs j) (make-list j #f)))

;; Dice's categorical (gen_discrete): from the most significant bit down,
;; bit k is a flip whose probability is the mass of the values with bit k
;; set among those that agree on the bits above, over their mass; one flip
;; for each distinct ratio, chosen by the bits above, settings of no mass
;; left out.
(define (discrete w ps)
  (define size (expt 2 w))
  (define given (list->vector ps))
  (define masses
    (for/vector ([i (in-range size)])
      (if (< i (vector-length given)) (inexact->exact (vector-ref given i)) 0)))
  (define (mass lo hi) (for/sum ([i (in-range lo hi)]) (vector-ref masses i)))
  (let level ([k (sub1 w)] [above '()])
    (cond
      [(< k 0) (reverse above)]
      [else
       (define span (expt 2 (add1 k)))
       (define flips (make-hash))
       (define table
         (for/vector ([u (in-range (quotient size span))])
           (define lo (* u span))
           (define total (mass lo (+ lo span)))
           (cond
             [(zero? total) 'none]
             [else
              (define r (exact->inexact (/ (mass (+ lo (quotient span 2)) (+ lo span)) total)))
              (hash-ref! flips r (λ () (cond [(= r 0) #f] [(= r 1) #t] [else (flip r)])))])))
       (level (sub1 k) (append above (list (choose above table))))])))
;; The entry of table for the setting of the bits `above` (most significant
;; first), constant where every setting of mass agrees.
(define (choose above table)
  (define vals (for/list ([x (in-vector table)] #:unless (eq? x 'none)) x))
  (cond
    [(null? vals) #f]
    [(andmap (λ (x) (eq? x (car vals))) vals) (car vals)]
    [else
     (define half (quotient (vector-length table) 2))
     (if (car above)
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table half))
         (choose (cdr above) (vector-copy table 0 half)))]))
(define (uniform w lo hi)
  (discrete w (for/list ([i (in-range hi)]) (if (< i lo) 0.0 (exact->inexact (/ 1 (- hi lo)))))))

(define (bits->natural bs)
  (for/sum ([b (in-list bs)] [i (in-naturals)]) (if b (expt 2 i) 0)))
(define (real p) (if (exact? p) (exact->inexact p) p))
;; Racket's `time` around the program's statements and its queries.
(define (start-clock)
  (vector (current-process-milliseconds) (current-inexact-milliseconds) (current-gc-milliseconds)))
(define (print-time c)
  (printf "cpu time: ~a real time: ~a gc time: ~a\n"
          (- (current-process-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 0))
          (inexact->exact (round (- (current-inexact-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 1))))
          (- (current-gc-milliseconds) (vector-ref c 2))))
(define (report-bool k pm)
  (printf "roulette ~a true ~a\n" k (real (pm #t)))
  (printf "roulette ~a false ~a\n" k (real (pm #f))))
(define (report-int k pm w)
  (define by-value (make-hash))
  (for ([(v p) (in-pmf pm)])
    (hash-set! by-value (bits->natural v) p))
  (for ([i (in-range (expt 2 w))])
    (printf "roulette ~a ~a ~a\n" k i (real (hash-ref by-value i 0)))))



(define clock (start-clock))
(define x1-pollution (discrete 1 (list 0.9 0.1)))
(define x2-smoker (discrete 1 (list 0.3 0.7)))
(define x3-cancer (bv-eq x1-pollution '(#f)))
(define x12-cancer (if x3-cancer (let ()
  (define x4-cancer (bv-eq x2-smoker '(#f)))
  (define x7-cancer (if x4-cancer (let ()
  (define x5-cancer (discrete 1 (list 0.03 0.97)))
  x5-cancer) (let ()
  (define x6-cancer (discrete 1 (list 0.001 0.999)))
  x6-cancer)))
  x7-cancer) (let ()
  (define x8-cancer (bv-eq x2-smoker '(#f)))
  (define x11-cancer (if x8-cancer (let ()
  (define x9-cancer (discrete 1 (list 0.05 0.95)))
  x9-cancer) (let ()
  (define x10-cancer (discrete 1 (list 0.02 0.98)))
  x10-cancer)))
  x11-cancer)))
(define x13-xray (bv-eq x12-cancer '(#f)))
(define x16-xray (if x13-xray (let ()
  (define x14-xray (discrete 1 (list 0.9 0.1)))
  x14-xray) (let ()
  (define x15-xray (discrete 1 (list 0.2 0.8)))
  x15-xray)))
(define x17-dyspnoea (bv-eq x12-cancer '(#f)))
(define x20-dyspnoea (if x17-dyspnoea (let ()
  (define x18-dyspnoea (discrete 1 (list 0.65 0.35)))
  x18-dyspnoea) (let ()
  (define x19-dyspnoea (discrete 1 (list 0.3 0.7)))
  x19-dyspnoea)))
(define x21-result (list x16-xray x20-dyspnoea))
(define pmfs (list (query (car x21-result) complement?) (query (cadr x21-result) complement?)))
(print-time clock)
(report-int 1 (list-ref pmfs 0) 1)
(report-int 2 (list-ref pmfs 1) 1)

module AleaProgram
using Alea
# Julia would spend more time optimizing the long straight-line functions
# below than running them takes: they are interpreted, and Alea's own
# methods compile as usual.
Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

const EV = Ref{AnyBool}(true)
observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

function shr(x::DistUInt{W}, n::Integer) where W
    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))
end

components(x::Tuple) = reduce(vcat, map(components, x); init = Any[])
components(x) = Any[x]
width(::DistUInt{W}) where W = W

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))
    pr(a, z, y, t...; evidence = e)
    nothing
end

function dice_main()
    x1_ASIA = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.01, 0.99])
    x2_TUB = prob_equals(x1_ASIA, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x2_TUB !== false
     x3_TUB = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.05, 0.95])
    end
    if x2_TUB !== true
     x4_TUB = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.01, 0.99])
    end
    x5_TUB = x2_TUB === true ? x3_TUB : x2_TUB === false ? x4_TUB : ifelse(x2_TUB, x3_TUB, x4_TUB)
    x6_SMOKE = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.5, 0.5])
    x7_LUNG = prob_equals(x6_SMOKE, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x7_LUNG !== false
     x8_LUNG = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.1, 0.9])
    end
    if x7_LUNG !== true
     x9_LUNG = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.01, 0.99])
    end
    x10_LUNG = x7_LUNG === true ? x8_LUNG : x7_LUNG === false ? x9_LUNG : ifelse(x7_LUNG, x8_LUNG, x9_LUNG)
    x11_BRONC = prob_equals(x6_SMOKE, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x11_BRONC !== false
     x12_BRONC = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.6, 0.4])
    end
    if x11_BRONC !== true
     x13_BRONC = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.3, 0.7])
    end
    x14_BRONC = x11_BRONC === true ? x12_BRONC : x11_BRONC === false ? x13_BRONC : ifelse(x11_BRONC, x12_BRONC, x13_BRONC)
    x15_EITHER = prob_equals(x10_LUNG, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x15_EITHER !== false
     x16_EITHER = prob_equals(x5_TUB, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x16_EITHER !== false
      x17_EITHER = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [1.0, 0.0])
     end
     if x16_EITHER !== true
      x18_EITHER = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [1.0, 0.0])
     end
     x19_EITHER = x16_EITHER === true ? x17_EITHER : x16_EITHER === false ? x18_EITHER : ifelse(x16_EITHER, x17_EITHER, x18_EITHER)
    end
    if x15_EITHER !== true
     x20_EITHER = prob_equals(x5_TUB, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x20_EITHER !== false
      x21_EITHER = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [1.0, 0.0])
     end
     if x20_EITHER !== true
      x22_EITHER = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.0, 1.0])
     end
     x23_EITHER = x20_EITHER === true ? x21_EITHER : x20_EITHER === false ? x22_EITHER : ifelse(x20_EITHER, x21_EITHER, x22_EITHER)
    end
    x24_EITHER = x15_EITHER === true ? x19_EITHER : x15_EITHER === false ? x23_EITHER : ifelse(x15_EITHER, x19_EITHER, x23_EITHER)
    x25_XRAY = prob_equals(x24_EITHER, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x25_XRAY !== false
     x26_XRAY = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.98, 0.02])
    end
    if x25_XRAY !== true
     x27_XRAY = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.05, 0.95])
    end
    x28_XRAY = x25_XRAY === true ? x26_XRAY : x25_XRAY === false ? x27_XRAY : ifelse(x25_XRAY, x26_XRAY, x27_XRAY)
    x29_DYSP = prob_equals(x14_BRONC, DistUInt{1}(0))
    if x29_DYSP !== false
     x30_DYSP = prob_equals(x24_EITHER, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x30_DYSP !== false
      x31_DYSP = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.9, 0.1])
     end
     if x30_DYSP !== true
      x32_DYSP = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.8, 0.2])
     end
     x33_DYSP = x30_DYSP === true ? x31_DYSP : x30_DYSP === false ? x32_DYSP : ifelse(x30_DYSP, x31_DYSP, x32_DYSP)
    end
    if x29_DYSP !== true
     x34_DYSP = prob_equals(x24_EITHER, DistUInt{1}(0))
     if x34_DYSP !== false
      x35_DYSP = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.7, 0.3])
     end
     if x34_DYSP !== true
      x36_DYSP = discrete(DistUInt{1}, [0.1, 0.9])
     end
     x37_DYSP = x34_DYSP === true ? x35_DYSP : x34_DYSP === false ? x36_DYSP : ifelse(x34_DYSP, x35_DYSP, x36_DYSP)
    end
    x38_DYSP = x29_DYSP === true ? x33_DYSP : x29_DYSP === false ? x37_DYSP : ifelse(x29_DYSP, x33_DYSP, x37_DYSP)
    x39_result = (x28_XRAY, x38_DYSP)
    return x39_result
end

function report(k, x, d)
    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

function run_program()
    EV[] = true
    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value
    for k in eachindex(comps)
        report(k, comps[k], dists[k])
    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))
end

warmup()
task = Task(run_program, 1 << 30)
schedule(task)
wait(task)
end
